title: Ticonderoga Pre-Sharpened #2 Pencils — 108 Count

comparisons.notes: Exact six-box, 18-per-box bundle; Pooky Toys on Walmart Marketplace. Available with $6.99 shipping, excluded from savings.

writeup: At $9.99 for 108 pre-sharpened pencils, this bundle works out to roughly nine cents per pencil. The exact six-box bundle was listed at $35.99 on Walmart Marketplace during our check, putting Woot 72% below that listing. Other pack sizes may offer better unit prices than this comparison, so this is most useful if you specifically want a large ready-to-use supply.
notes: Woot’s headline specifies six boxes of 18 pencils; its generic description contains conflicting pack-count copy. Confirm the 108-count selection before ordering. Marketplace shipping is excluded from the comparison; this is not a claim that $35.99 is the lowest price across every retailer.
amazon_match_notes: Pre-sharpened yellow #2 HB pencils, six boxes of 18 (108 total).
